content.title: 2014 AHA/ACC NSTE-ACS Guideline
content.focus: The guideline provides recommendations for the management of acute coronary syndrome, particularly non-ST-elevation myocardial infarction (NSTE-ACS). It emphasizes the importance of clinical pathways, diagnostic protocols, and intervention strategies in managing acute coronary conditions.
references: Bonow RO, Masoudi FA, Rumsfeld JS, et al.
Krumholz HM, Anderson JL, Bachelder BL
Le May MR, So DR, Dionne R, et al.
